knownQuirks: [
  "**Preferred connector is MuleSoft Forge IDP Connector:** io.github.mulesoft-forge:mule-idp-connector v1.0.6. Universal IDP connector that works across all action versions without connector sprawl. Requires Mule 4.6+ AND requires adding mavenCentral() repo to pom.xml because Forge connectors are hosted on Maven Central, NOT Anypoint Exchange. Operations: 'Service IDP - Execution - Submit' and 'Service IDP - Execution Result - Retrieve'. (Source: connector-registry.json — web-search-2026-05-11.)",
  "**Fallback path is HTTP connector against IDP REST API:** Use only if Forge connector is not viable. Base URL: https://idp-rt.{region}.anypoint.mulesoft.com/api/v1/ (regions: us-east-1, eu-central-1). POST submit: body = { file: <base64>, fileName: <name.pdf> }. GET poll: /executions/{id}/v2 (note the /v2 suffix). Token URL: https://anypoint.mulesoft.com/accounts/api/v2/oauth2/token. (Source: connector-registry.json — anypoint-idp entry.)",
  "**Async submit/poll pattern — not request-reply:** POST submit returns an execution ID. Caller must poll GET /executions/{id}/v2 until terminal status. Status values: ACKNOWLEDGED | IN_PROGRESS | RESULTS_PENDING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED | PARTIAL_SUCCESS | MANUAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED. Default polling: 10 attempts × 3s = 30s timeout. Min polling interval enforced by IDP quota: 10s.",
